name: 15203 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15203 (Pittsburgh) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15203 (Pittsburgh) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
